text:
Maria Chen: Hey team — had a CostFuse demo today. Quick notes and a few clarifying Qs before we escalate to procurement. TL;DR: mixed per-seat + usage model, egress/storage fees, 12mo minimum on the standard quote.

Ajay Patel: Can you paste the pricing lines here so we can compare apples-to-apples?

Maria Chen: Sure — excerpt from the quote:```
CostFuse quote:
- Seats: $30/user/month (min 10 seats)
- API usage: $0.0015 / 1k tokens
- Embeddings: $0.00075 / vector
- Storage/egress: $0.02 / GB / month
- Priority support add-on: $1,500 / mo
- 10% annual renewal escalator
```

Leo Kim: That API token price is ~2x what we pay today. Do they offer batching or volume discounts beyond the min? How do they justify it (latency, model family, quantization)?

Maria Chen: They claim better throughput on medium seq lengths and have a quantization/FP16 option. They offered a 20% discount if we commit to 100k tokens/day and a custom quantization profile for our models.

Sarah O'Neill: Need to confirm security/compliance: SOC2, data residency, audit logs retention, and SSO (SAML). Also invoice cadence — monthly or quarterly?

Priya Rao: Legal note: we'll need standard termination-for-convenience, clear data deletion on termination, and indemnity limits. I'll review T&Cs but would prefer to see commercial terms before signing.

FinOps Bot: Usage alert: current avg tokens/day with existing vendor = 62k. Projection +30% next quarter based on product roadmap.

Ajay Patel: Any onboarding credits or migration assistance? Also ask if embeddings are separately metered or included in token counts.

Maria Chen: They offered $10k onboarding credit + a 30-day POC with reduced rate limits. Embeddings are billed separately per-vector (see line).

Priya Rao: I can join the procurement call to cover legal redlines. Also request exportable audit logs for a 1yr retention at minimum.

Leo Kim: SLA ask: do they commit 99.9% inference endpoint availability? If not, we need a fallback routing policy (dedicated/hosted mix).

Maria Chen: I'll push on SLA and ask for a written SOW covering throughput guarantees. If tokens pricing stays high, propose negotiating committed usage tiers or seat buy-down for first year.

Ajay Patel: Sounds good — thanks. Please share updated quote after the call and any redlines from Priya.

Maria Chen: Will do. Setting up procurement 1:1 Tue 10am PST — @Priya Rao please join.

Priya Rao: :thumbsup: I'll be there and will prepare key redlines.

Ajay Patel: +1, thanks everyone.
